blocks.text: 'Biotechnology' means technology based on biology: the use of organisms, biological processes or systems to make products that improve human lives and the environment. It aims to solve complex problems in medicine, agriculture and industry. This chapter deals with its most important part, genetic engineering.

blocks.title: For information
blocks.text: Traditional biotechnology has been used for thousands of years in fermentation, to make foods such as bread and cheese. Modern biotechnology emerged in the 20th century, after the structure of DNA was discovered and advanced molecular techniques developed.

blocks.title: Genetic engineering
blocks.text: Biotechnology is a broad umbrella term, but its true engine is genetic engineering: the alteration of an organism's DNA to change its traits or capabilities, by inserting, deleting or modifying genes, and sometimes by transferring genes between different species.
